games.name: [UPD] Ice Fishing Simulator 🐟
games.desc:
💎 Use code 'BLOODMOON' for 500 Gems
🎃 HALLOWEEN: Blood Moon nights, a pumpkin patch and spooky new catches for a limited time!

🐟 Catch, Collect, Cash In!
Drill your ice hole and reel in fish of every rarity, including rare Albino, Gold and Void variants. Fill your coolers and sell at the Fish Market, where prices shift every in-game day.

🔥 Cook Your Catch!
Cut fish into fillets and cook dishes on a grill or smoker for timed boosts. Discover new recipes in bottles you reel in!

🛠️ Upgrade Everything!
Better rods, reels and lures, bigger coolers, and auto poles that fish for you. Tools and furnishings roll their own buffs, so chase the perfect roll!

🏆 Daily Tournaments!
Compete for the luckiest catch and the most fish caught each day to win trophies.

🎨 Build Your Spot!
Decorate around your ice hole with furnishings that boost your luck, and paint them with the Color Bar.

🎉 +10% coins with a friend in your server, and +10% more for joining the group!

games.name: LOCOfficial!
games.desc:
Match cards based on color or symbol, and be the first one to clear your hand to win!

🌟PICK YOUR OWN RULES
Whether it's the ability to chain cards, swap hands, or playing a straightforward game without adding anything new, you have a vast choice of customization to play the game in your own liking.

🤝TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS
You can have a classic game against all of your friends, or, hop onto teams mode, where you can team up with your friends against a different team to strategize and rig the odds to your team's favor.


The game supports all platforms, including PC, Mobile, Console, and even VR!
